title: App Store Connect API key
summary: .p8 key file + Key ID + Issuer ID — for TestFlight and App Store uploads.
why: fastlane uses this key to upload the iOS build to TestFlight/App Store and to manage certificates/profiles automatically (without 2FA prompts).
prerequisites: **Admin** role in App Store Connect (required to create the key).
The **store-accounts** record must be completed; the key is created in that account.

steps.title: **Integrations** tab → **App Store Connect API** → **Team Keys**
steps.detail: If this is your first time, request access with *Request Access*; approval is instant.

steps.title: Download the key
steps.detail: **Download API Key** → `AuthKey_XXXXXXXXXX.p8`. This file can be downloaded **only once**.

steps.title: Copy the Key ID and Issuer ID
steps.detail: The Key ID is on the key's row in the list; the Issuer ID is shown above the table.

warnings: Do not act in the wrong account: the account/team name on the page must match the one in the **store-accounts** record (RULES.md Section 12.8).
If the .p8 file is lost it cannot be downloaded again; you must revoke the key and generate a new one.
